book.body: Record an expense once and Abniyah bills it across units by their shares. Payments, balances and statements reconcile automatically, for the whole compound and for each block. Export a clean PDF whenever the committee asks.

arabic.title: Arabic and English, born bilingual

h1.title: Register
h1.body: Create your account, name your building, compound or organization, and start a 30-day free trial. No payment details.

h2.title: Set up in minutes
h2.body: Follow the checklist: blocks, units, people, licenses. Import from Excel if you already keep records.

h3.title: Collect on autopilot
h3.body: Expenses become charges, residents get receipts, and Abniyah sends the monthly payment reminders for you.

landing.pricingSub: Every feature included. Start with 30 days free, cancel anytime.

pricing.p1: All features, all channels: WhatsApp, email and in-app
pricing.p2: Unlimited managers and residents per unit

landing.aboutBody1: Abniyah is built and operated by Tatawwor, a Beirut-based technology company whose team earned its experience in Australia, New Zealand and the United Kingdom. We build it the way we run our own systems: security enforced in the database, daily backups, and no shortcuts.

privacy.q: Who can see my building's data?
privacy.a: Only your building's authorized managers see its residents and finances, and residents see their own units. Access rules are enforced at the database level on every request. Details are in our Privacy Policy.

arabic.q: Does it really work in Arabic?
arabic.a: Yes. The full app, including notifications, works in Arabic with proper right-to-left layout. Every user picks their own language.

payments.a: Today, money changes hands as your building prefers (cash, transfer) and management records it in Abniyah; residents see their balance and receipts instantly. Direct in-app payment via Whish is on our roadmap.

price.q: What does it cost after the trial?
price.a: $5 per unit per month, or $50 per unit per year (about 17% less). One license covers one unit, with all features and no hidden extras.

residents.a: Their own login showing their balance, charges and receipts, building announcements and meetings, the ability to report maintenance issues with photos, and notifications on WhatsApp or email in their language.

landing.ctaTitle: Ready to run your building like a pro?
landing.ctaBody: Set up your building today. Free for 30 days, and your data stays yours.

f1.title: The building book
f1.body: Every expense, charge and payment in one ledger. The compound view and each block reconcile to the cent.

f2.title: Dues & collections
f2.body: Issue monthly dues or bill actual expenses. Owners see their balance; managers see who has paid.

f3.title: WhatsApp & email updates
f3.body: Receipts, new charges and dues reach residents on WhatsApp and email, in Arabic and English.

f4.title: Issues & maintenance
f4.body: Residents report problems with photos; managers track them from reported to resolved.

f5.title: Meetings & decisions
f5.body: Schedule building meetings with calendar invites, keep minutes and decisions where everyone finds them.

f6.title: Compounds & portfolios
f6.body: One account for a single building, a compound of blocks, or a whole management company.

landing.whoFor: Abniyah serves owners' committees, building supervisors, and property-management companies, from a single block to a portfolio of compounds. One login per person: manage your buildings, or simply follow your own home.

dues.reconcileNote: Amount due = base − current balance (surplus/deficit carried automatically).
dues.flatFeeNote: Flat fee: the full base amount is charged every period, regardless of current balance.
dues.poolPartyHint: Billed to the tenant where a unit is leased, to the owner otherwise.
dues.ownerPoolHint: Charged to owners only, every period, on top of the recurring budget. Leave at 0 if there is none. For a one-time amount use a special charge instead.
dues.customPartyHint: Recurring is billed to the tenant where a unit is leased; owner-only is always the owner's.
dues.offBudgetNote: A one-time charge outside the recurring budget, allocated across units, with its own due date. Use it when the fund needs money now rather than at the next generation. A party's carry-in applies to the total of their recurring and special amounts.
dues.billToOwnerHint: For capital work on the property (roof, elevator, facade). Follows ownership, never the occupant.
dues.billToTenantHint: For a running cost that landed off-cycle, like a fuel surcharge. Same rule as the recurring budget: the tenant where a unit is leased, the owner where it is not.
dues.arrearsBlocked: Issuing dues is turned off until it is switched.
